title: Concept: Composer lockfile without a content hash
description: composer.lock declares a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Composer cannot tell whether the lockfile matches `composer.json`, so an install can proceed from a stale lock the review never covered.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.lock (composer).
risk: Composer cannot tell whether the lockfile matches `composer.json`, so an install can proceed from a stale lock the review never covered.
